Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Private terrace, access to a barbecue hut with a fire pit outside.
Many nice marked hiking trails nearby. Free parking with electric car charger.

The space
Student housing of 84 sqm on one level with direct access to a private terrace.
 By car, you can drive to Oslo Airport in 25 minutes and to Eidsvoll station in 15 minutes. From there, the train takes only 36 minutes to Oslo S. and 45 minutes to Hamar, if that is relevant.

Guest access
Outdoor area with fire pit and barbecue house/old pig house.

What an amazing place. Too bad we were only there one night. You will immediately feel at home in the cozy and very spacious house. Anything you need is present. Good bathroom and spacious kitchen. You can sit anywhere outside, so there's always sun. Best overnight stay of the vacation and at a very low price. Beautiful area with lots of hiking and biking possibilities. The train station is 10 minutes by car, and then you are at the airport in 10 minutes and in Oslo in 25 minutes.
